tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / /dbyer med bla ma la btud nas/ /'dod don kun 'grub sbyin sreg gis/ /lag len gsal bar bshad kyis nyon/ /'dir sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i gang zag gis sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang rang gzhan gyi rim gro sogs 'dod don sgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab dang (ma dper yig phreng gcig mi gsal ba'i ma mthong ngo /)gnyis kyi 'phrin bcol gyi rjes su sa phyogs 'dir 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang sems can gyi don bgyid par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la bstsal zhing sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de gshegs gsol sogs bya bgegs gtor gyi rjes su sa'i phyogs 'di sogs gong ltar las 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar/ 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces pa dang khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyi phyogs kun tu brabs pa'i bgegs thams cad byer bar bsam pa ni sa slang ba'o/ /de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs thams cad lag pas bcags la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsam pa ni sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas thab khung bur byed na rgyar khru gang / dpangs su khru phyed brko/

mchur sor bzhi bkyed pa kha khyer de nas mu ran dpangs su sor bzhi brtsigs ba'i khar pad+ma'i phreng ba'am/ rdo rwa bya de'i pha rol gru bzhir dkar por byas la gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rje bya thab phyin thams cad kha dog dkar por bya/ nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar ut+pal la dkar po'am/ tshom bu sogs lha'i mtshan ma bya'o/ /bris thab byed na/ gzhi ma thas par byas la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la khru phyed kyis dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang / de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi bskor kha khyer dang / slar yang (ma dper yig 'phreng gcig mi gsal ba'o/)bzhi dang / de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse lnga nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi tshad kyi cha kha gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni bri cha mig sngar mdzes pa dang / sgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba la pad+ma'i lte ba dang / phyi'i sum gnyis la pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang / thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar por bya/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zlum pa'i phreng bas bskor/ bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skyas bya/ lte bar ut+pal dkar po'i tshon phung ngam/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de yang rje btsun ma'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan pa'i mtshan ma 'god lugs sogs shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bud shing ni pa la sha'am/ tsher ma can ma yin pa 'o ma can yam shing gi tshad kyang 'di nyid do gyi shing sor brgyad pa yan chad khru gang tsam brtsigs/ de ma 'byor na srog chags med pa'i ba glang sogs kyi lci bas thab ka kha khyer steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang bzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba me ni rdo dang lcags brtsub pa las byung ma yin pa rgyun zhag gi me'am/

'o ma can brtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas ni bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o/ /lnga pa bsham thabs ni thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang gi chu ku shas mthor yab dang bcas pa dang / grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pas me yol dkar zhal gyi byugs pa waṃ yig dkar po bris pa'ang / rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang / rje btsun ma/ me lha/ phyogs skyong 'byung po gzhi bdag rnams la zlum gtor re re dang bgegs gtor rnams bsham/ g.yas su rang ngos nas brtsams te thabs kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma/ /gro dang dur ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham/ /ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar rnams stabs gang bder bzhag yo byad thams cad dri bzang gis chus gtor te bzhag go /drug pa sgrub pa po ni snga dro'i dus rang nyid khrus byas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskangs zhing nus pa dbyung ba dang sdig pa dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan pos sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bltas te dkyil krung ngam/ pus 'khyud dang bcas pas tsog bu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsgom pa rig byed 'don pa lta bus spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsangs/ /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /zhes pa ltar las dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod bya ba'i bar thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha sogs lugs mthun gyi mngon rtogs bsgom/

sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te yam shing mar la sbags pa'i rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyi thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing yi ge bcu pa lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcings pa'i mthe bong bcang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blug bzung la/ blug gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blug gzar gyi mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyi bsang chu la oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pa'i byin gyis rlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang / swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me dri/ zhal zas gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas rnams dang / yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las grub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod la mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gis sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing /

oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams kyi byin gyis rlob/ bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thab swa bha was sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung bas zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan ba bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur bar bsam mo/ /lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ thab kyi nang du me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes dkar po la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa'am/ yang na phyag bzhi pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po mes rang bzhin dmar po zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ bsam/ de'i thugs kha'i raṃ dang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyi bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzāḥzhes dang / lag pa gnyis mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/

/me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā da ka ma hā bhu te de wa ri ṣi dwi dza sa ta ma gṛ hī tā ā hūm̐ tiṃ ā ha ra/ asmin san ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā yā twaṃ zhes brjod la thab tu me rtog gcig phul te thab kyi shar lhor pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa bsam la/ oṃ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ pa d+yaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dz+wā la ya sarba bhasmī na ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa tri ṣ+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya satwaṃ gyi dam la bzhag oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥl sogs pa'i dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan par (ma dper tshig kha shas mi gsal)mgo bor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga ghaṇ+ṭe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jig byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thams dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste/

oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa a zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim par phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo/ /de nas bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te/ a mṛ ta'am yak+ṣa brjod pas bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsam ste/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjo+od cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyi dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā/ dī byā ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā hā nā ya swā hā/ /zhes brjod/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo/ /de lta bu lan gsum gyi byon zan phul de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la yam shing la sogs pa'i 'og nas byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams rim bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul lo/ /oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa swā hā yam shing / oṃ ag+na ye swā hā mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ dā sha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zhos dang sbyar bas zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puk+ṣa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasmā ra ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti hā ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am yang na/ sngags de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ yag+na ye 'ba' zhig gis phul/

gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba'i mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes las sngags kyi spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod do/ /de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang bstod pa sngar ltar byas te/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ mchod yon dang / oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hās bsang gtor phul la/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las mi 'dra ba'i khyad bar rang nyid ces pa'i tshab tu de nyid ces par 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /de nas spro na spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis sbyangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyi gdan phul la mchod pas mchod/ oṃ ar+ya tā ra sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ta baṃ/ badz+ra a be sha ya/ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug cing dbang du bya/ de nas dbang lha spyan drangs nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bskor bar gyur zhes brjod cing bsam la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bsdu ba'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam la/

slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsangs chus gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsas btab te oṃ tā re tu t+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyi blug gzar gyi mar blug pa'i dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pya zhes sogs swā hā'i gong du bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pa'i byon skyems phul/ de nas yo ga ltar mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas rol mo'i bar dang / spro na rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga rnams kun rig ltar ro/ /bstod pa ni/ oṃ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs nas/ 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / spro na 'dod don gsol btab ni/ 'phrin las rang bzhin lha mo khyed bstod pas/ /seng ge glang chen me dang rkun po dgra/ /gdug pa'i sbrul dang brtson khang chu bo'i 'jigs/ /mi zad 'byung po'i gdon las bskyab tu gsol/ /glo bur 'chi dang rims nad drag po dang / /byad dang 'byung bzhi'i rkyen dbang mi 'gro bar/ /tshe ring bde bar gnas nas lam bsgrub par/ /'phrin las lha mo khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid gsum sdug bsngal me yi nang 'dug nas/ /shin tu brnag dka'i gdung bas bsregs lags na/ /byang sems ri bong 'dzin pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /nyes pa'i nad 'di sel bar mdzad du gsol/ /chags dang 'jig lta 'dam rdzab 'di bgos nas/ /gnas lugs rin chen mthong bar ma gyur na/ /khyod thugs gaṅga'i chu rgyun dri med kyis/

/yang dag ye shes snang ba bskyed du gsol/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i sa lam gyis/ /theg pa'i mchog la rim gyis legs bgrod de/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang mthon po nas/ /sdug bsngal ldan pa'i 'gro la gzigs par shog /ces gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab bo/ /de nas yaṃ shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde mtshan re re'i thog mar so so'i sngags bo dhi brik+ṣā la sogs pa'i sngags gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor ba 'bul/ rdzas thams cad yi ge bcu pa 'ba' zhig gis phul la logs nas sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung / bsnyen pa kha gso la sogs pa'i dus su nub re la til stong phrag lnga'am/ khri la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa 'bul zhing skabs su yaṃ shing dang mar ci 'byor ba 'bul/ sgrub g.yog gcig gi me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang 'jug go /de la yaṃ shing ni byang chub shing du mos la me 'od 'bar ba la/ til dang zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha thams kyi zhal du gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu dūr ba dang ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blug gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba rol mo'i bar dang / bstod pa bya/ 'das pa'i gtor ma rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang / rdo rje me'i sngags rgyas sbyangs/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs pa'i tshul dang / a kā ros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i sbu gu'i gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / snying po'i mthar ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas dbul/ mchod bstod dang mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la sogs kyi 'phrin las gzhol/

de nas phyogs skyong 'byung po rnams la cha gsum ltar dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma byin rlabs cha gsum ltar la lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis bsngos nas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ de nas bgegs la cha gsum ltar btang ngo / /skabs 'dir lhag chad kha bskangs ba'i bsam pa'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ de nas bgegs la cha gsum ltar btang ngo / /skabs 'dir lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bsam pa'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs dang / bdag cag las dang po pa rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang gi cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes la me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang / 'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskangs/ las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no/ /dang po me lha mchod pa ni thab khung du mar blug gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pa blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod de me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can gyur par bsam la bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba phul/

mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ gnyis pa me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gcig bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyi rlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa ba ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum lngas phul mtshan sngags re re'i nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi skur sprul pa/ /rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhal dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa chibs/ /rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang 'phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gun+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba rnyed kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ gsum pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chad dang / sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad bsgyur te/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi lhag chad kha bskang la/ mchod yon dang bsang gtor sngar bzhin phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyi bsgrubs kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/

/bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang / dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyi gnas gsum srungs/ /dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun sogs kyi smon lam ci shes dang / che ba'i che mchog sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o/ /drug pa ni mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na/ me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la thal ba 'dod pa rnams la'ang sbyin zhing lhag ma 'bab chu la sogs par dor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas rung ngo / /thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis bya'o/ /de ltar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /sbyin sreg 'di ni skyes chen gong ma yi/ /gsung gi nying khu bsdus pa'i legs bshad de/ /lag len rtogs bla 'dod don kun grub yin/ /'on kyang bdag blo dman pa'i skyon chags pa'i/ /nyes tshogs mchis na 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags/ /legs pa'i dge des bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dbang phyug myur thob shog /'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i ngo bo rje btsun bla ma dam pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ snyoms las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrīs mdzad pa'i yi ge dang / gzhan yang yi ge rnying pa du ma la gzhi byas bla ma mkhas pa'i phyag len gyis legs par brgyan nas shin tu myur bar bris pa dge legs 'phel/ 'di ni lag len tsam gsal bar bkod pa yin la de yang bsnyen pa kha skong la bsnyen sngags ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i grangs kyi til yi ge bcu pas 'bul ba yin no/

/gzhan tshe sgrub dang rim gro sogs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi gsal kha ni 'dir yi ge mang gis dogs pas ma bris shing logs su 'chad par spro'o/ /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza gat+taṃ/ ༄༅/ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho bzhugs/ ār+ya ta re na maḥsgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sngon du song nas/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas/ rang gzhan gyi rim gro tshe sgrub sogs kyi bsgyur dgos la/ hūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru do pa/ dpangs su khru gang pa/ kha khyer la rin po che dang ut+pala'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ bri bya la thab stegs med/ me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ rigs bdag rin 'byung / spel tshig bdag gam/ sbyin pa'i bdag po ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor ba sogs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ khyad par gyi rdzas/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ dūr wa rnams gang mang 'bul zhing grangs sogs rdzas gzhan rnams kyang brgya rtsa brgyad re 'bul/ cho ga'i chings dang ngag 'don zhi ba dang 'dra'o/ /mnyam med kun dga'i tshul khrims kyi zin tho gzhir bzhag nas dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bkod pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
